text = input('Transactions (sender,recipient,amount separated by |): ')
accounts = {}
for line in text.split('|'):
    sender, recipient, amount = line.split(',')
    amount = int(amount)   # cell values are text
    if sender == 'PRE-MINE':
        accounts.setdefault(recipient, 0)
        accounts[recipient] += amount
    else:
        accounts.setdefault(sender, 0)
        accounts.setdefault(recipient, 0)
        accounts[sender] -= amount
        accounts[recipient] += amount
print(accounts)
total = 0
for amount in accounts.values():
    total += amount
print('Total Boringcoins:', total)

def column_letter(n):
    letters = ''
    while n > 0:
        n, r = divmod(n, 26)
        if r == 0:
            r = 26
            n -= 1
        letters = chr(64 + r) + letters
    return letters
print(column_letter(len(accounts)), column_letter(999))
